title: Sacked by Crusaders First
sentences: Constantinople had already been sacked once, by Christian crusaders.
In 1204, the Fourth Crusade turned away from its goal of Jerusalem.
Carried by Venetian ships, the crusaders attacked the Christian city instead.
For three days, they looted churches, palaces and homes.
Four bronze horses from the Hippodrome ended up in Venice, at Saint Mark's.
Crusaders ruled the city until 1261, when the Byzantines took it back.
